deterministic.reason: A run report exists for HEAD 548b159; the run remains incomplete because the implementation itself is an uncommitted worktree diff.
The actions.rs change only synchronizes stream cache/rebind state; command documentation surfaces carry no affected semantics.
URL is too generic and matched unrelated concepts; feature-specific passages were read and the active main-frame sweep passed.
The only non-trail repository hit is the vendored CDP schema, which already declares the consumed event.
100 iterations passed with seed 1677; 20 iterations each also passed with seeds 1677, 42, and 9001.
The streaming URL E2E passed 10 consecutive runs, and all three Lightpanda E2Es passed together.
Removing the main-frame ID predicate made the E2E fail on forbidden-2-active-child; restoring it passed 100 iterations.
Removing is_main made the real Lightpanda E2E emit /child and fail; restoring it made the Lightpanda matrix green.
45 changed symbols and 198 impacted items, but 0 resolved edges, 2402 unresolved calls, 74 unmapped SCIP entries, and rust-analyzer duplicate-symbol errors make the map strongly under-covering.

findings.claim: Non-Chrome background full navigation could replace the active cached and emitted URL.
findings.evidence: The previous full-navigation predicate treated every non-screencast engine event as active. Independent reviewers identified the reachable Lightpanda path; the code now filters every engine by active CDP session.

findings.claim: A late event from the old active session could be attributed to the new active tab during tab switching.
findings.evidence: The command path previously updated last_tabs before updating cdp_session_id. The fix binds them under a consistent lock order and publish_url rechecks the live session. Removing that recheck makes test_old_session_event_cannot_replace_new_active_tab_url fail.
findings.layer: cross-task ordering and end-to-end tab attribution
findings.path: tab_switch -> broadcast_tabs/session rebind -> cdp_event_loop -> publish_url -> WebSocket consumer

findings.claim: Documentation initially advertised History API and fragment URL updates without the Chrome scope.
findings.evidence: The implementation deliberately gates Page.navigatedWithinDocument on Chrome. README, CLI help, docs, and skill text now say so.

findings.claim: A late timed-out Page.getFrameTree response can corrupt a retry.
findings.evidence: CdpClient PendingGuard removes the cancelled command entry, late responses have no pending receiver, and a real frameNavigated value is never overwritten by a seed.

findings.claim: The new lock order can deadlock stream readers or URL publishers.
findings.evidence: All two-lock paths acquire cdp_session_id before last_tabs; other readers acquire only one of those locks.

findings.claim: Command documentation must change because actions.rs is touched.
findings.evidence: The actions.rs delta only synchronizes internal stream binding/cache state and adds no command, argument, result, or user-facing command semantics.

findings.claim: Lightpanda 0.3.6 cannot reach a multiple-page state for real background-tab verification.
findings.evidence: Target.createTarget returned TargetAlreadyLoaded in the real E2E, matching open upstream issue lightpanda-io/browser#1962. Active main-frame and child-frame routing were verified against the real runtime.

findings.claim: The ordered non-frame broadcast remains lossy for lagging receivers.
findings.evidence: The channel is intentionally bounded and documented as non-durable; replaying bounded initialization URL events can contribute to lag but does not create an unbounded queue.

exemptions.claim: Command docs are unaffected by the actions.rs synchronization change.
exemptions.evidence: No command, flag, wire shape, result field, or command behavior changed.

exemptions.claim: The generic URL sibling sweep is not a useful completeness oracle for this change.
exemptions.evidence: It matched unrelated URL concepts while the feature-specific active main-frame sweep passed and all streaming passages were read.

exemptions.claim: The vendored CDP protocol schema needs no edit.
exemptions.evidence: It already declares Page.navigatedWithinDocument and the code only begins consuming that existing event.

exemptions.claim: MCP documentation and schema need no edit.
exemptions.evidence: The stream wire message shape and all commands remain unchanged.

issue_candidates.title: Enable real Lightpanda background-tab stream coverage when multiple pages are supported
issue_candidates.evidence: Lightpanda 0.3.6 returns TargetAlreadyLoaded from Target.createTarget; upstream issue lightpanda-io/browser#1962 tracks the same limitation.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: agent-browser cannot create the runtime state until Lightpanda implements multiple pages; the session predicate remains covered by the Lightpanda CDP harness.

issue_candidates.title: Evaluate coalescing buffered initialization URL events
issue_candidates.evidence: The ordered channel is bounded and non-durable; up to 64 buffered URLs may be replayed when the frame-tree seed resolves.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Delivery durability and URL-event coalescing are separate stream protocol decisions.
